name: Sugar Factory Zeeland
scope: The standing De Zeeland former sugar factory on Markiezaatsweg in Bergen op Zoom. Includes its three industrial halls, low links and measured retail-era external additions.
era: Surviving heritage halls after adaptive reuse. Historic brickwork details follow the original Qualla photograph, and rebuilt roof volumes follow Dutch survey elevations.

originalReview.notes: The exact own-work image already published on Qualla identifies the surviving brick hall profiles and masonry rhythms. It is pre-conversion and supplies no current glazing, signage or fine roof details. The upload caption and image camera clock differ on capture date.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Started with Harvey Nuytemans’s exact public-domain Qualla image and confirmed its original author-declared release. No contemporary photo of the renovation was used. Native map and numerical survey establish the standing roof configurations.
